text:
jeff wu: opened PR to patch Optimize Toolkit docs: example snippets still reference old `Batcher` ctor and a few links are broken in the i18n branch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/731

maria ramos: thanks @jeff. I'll take the Go/JS snippet swaps. For examples, we should prefer ContinuousBatcher + optional KV prefetch and show a shortseq quant profile note.

clare docs: FYI the Spanish and Japanese translations already pulled the old snippet, so we'll need to update the localized files too to avoid mismatch. I'll prepare a parallel patch in /i18n/* once the canonical snippet is updated.

jeff wu: good catch @clare. let's update canonical snippet at /examples/optimize/continuous_kv_prefetch/{go,js,py} and then sync i18n. CI needs internal example paths to extract snippets correctly.

ux-jo: tiny UX ask: include a 2-row mini-table (legacy vs prefetch+continuous) showing tokens/sec and p95 latency for short sequences. Also change header from "KV-prefetch" to "KV prefetch (optional)" so it's not prescriptive.

maria ramos: adding the table and header tweak. also adding runnable commands for each language:
```bash
# Go
go run ./examples/optimize/continuous_kv_prefetch/go --profile shortseq --batch continuous
# JS
node ./examples/optimize/continuous_kv_prefetch/js/run.js --profile shortseq
```

maria ramos: proposed Go snippet (short):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
cb := optimize.NewContinuousBatcher(client, optimize.WithKVPrefetch())
res, err := cb.Generate(ctx, "Summarize: ...", optimize.WithQuantProfile("shortseq"))
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(res.Text)
```

ijeff wu: add fallback note: "If KV prefetch misses, requests fall back to single-request path; expect ~1.7-1.9x p95." and a one-line legacy mapping: "Legacy: Batcher(...) ≈ ContinuousBatcher(...) with auto-flush off."

clare docs: i'm preparing the i18n updates. question: do we translate the perf numbers or mark them as examples? better to mark as illustrative so translators don't need numeric edits.

ux-jo: mark as illustrative and keep a small caption: "Results are illustrative; run microbench for your workload."

jeff wu: replaced external gist links with internal paths in PR. left a TODO in docs to add a short note about pinning quant profiles in Dedicated configs with a crosslink to /dedicated/configure-quant-profiles.

ci-bot: docs-checks #731 started

ci-bot: docs-checks #731 failed  snippet-extract: missing example path in JS file 

maria ramos: fixing the JS snippet path now, updating the code fence ID for extraction. pushing shortly.

ci-bot: docs-checks #731 running again

ci-bot: docs-checks #731 passed  https://ci.redwood.internal/731/checks/12  :white_check_mark:

jeff wu: thanks all. @clare please open the i18n PRs after this merges so translators get the updated canonical source.

clare docs: will do. i'll target es + ja first, then zh. i'll include a tiny note in the translation guide: "Do not translate example commands or internal paths."

maria ramos: LGTM. approving. thanks for the quick fixes everyone :tada:

jeff wu: merging after CI green

ci-bot: merge complete. PR #731 merged by jeff wu at 1755554888
